IntroducedBillHeader.Sponsors: Representatives Eddy, Takko, Armstrong, Sells, Simpson, and Springer

Bill.BriefDescription: Requiring the provision of a secure internet-based system to generate temporary permits to operate vehicles.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to a secure internetbased system to generatetemporary permits to operate vehicles; and amending RCW 46.16.047.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecAmd.BegSecText: RCW 46.16.047 and 1961 c 12 s 46.16.047 are each amendedto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) Forms for such temporary permits shall be prescribed andfurnished by the department. Temporary permits shall bear consecutivenumbers, shall show the name and address of the applicant, trade nameof the vehicle, model, year, type of body, identification number anddate of application, and shall be such as may be affixed to the vehicleat the time of issuance, and remain on such vehicle only during theperiod of such registration and until the receipt of permanent licenseplates. The application shall be registered in the office of theperson issuing the permit and shall be forwarded by him to thedepartment each day together with the fee accompanying it. A fee of fifty cents shall be charged by the person authorized toissue such permit which shall be accounted for in the same manner asthe other fees collected by such officers, provided that such fees p. 1 HB 3029collected by county auditors or their agents shall be paid to thecounty treasurer in the same manner as other fees collected by thecounty auditor and credited to the county current expense fund. (2) By July 1, 2009, the department shall provide a secureinternetbased system that allows temporary permits to be generated andprinted on demand by persons authorized to issue a temporary permit.By July 1, 2011, all temporary permits must be generated using thedesignated secure internetbased system.
